review.note: Retracted in M22: an attempt on the life of Fernando da Costa Rolo on 19 March 1981. The atlas holds no record of the armed far left — not the PRP-BR, not the FP-25, not the trials — so there is nothing for an action of theirs to attach to in either direction, and any edge would be invented. Revisit once the organisations themselves are here.

title: assassination attempt on Fernando da Costa Rolo
summary: Wikidata item Q115635121, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "attack perpetrated by the Popular Forces 25 de Abril, in Malveira, in March 1981". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
